title: BAND-MAID Perform New Ending Theme Song for Beyblade X Anime's Beykingdom Arc
content: The "Beykingdom Arc" will premiere on October 9 on the franchise 's official YouTube channel. The Beyblade X anime premiered in Japan on TV Tokyo and its affiliates in October 2023. The anime entered the "True Future Arc" last April. The anime premiered globally in July 2024. Disney XD is airing the series.
author: ANN

title: Viz Media, Japan Society Screen World Premiere of Hirayasumi Anime on October 7
content: The anime will premiere in January 2027 in Japan on the NHK General channel. Viz Media also announced in English a 2027 release. title: Earth Defense Force 6.2 Invaders From Another World Game Launches on March 18
content: D3Publisher announced at the Tokyo Game Show 2026 on Friday that it will release Earth Defense Force 6.2 INVADERS FROM ANOTHER WORLD, an updated version of its Earth Defense Force 6 game, on March 18, 2027. The Earth Defense Force 6 game launched in Japan in August 2022 for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5.

title: Even the Student Council Has its Holes! TV Anime Reveals Ending Theme in 2nd Main Promo Video
content: The staff for the television anime of Muchimaro 's Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! ( Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ) four-panel manga revealed the second main promotional video and ending theme song artist on Friday.

title: Suikoden Anime Reveals Third Trailer, Ending Theme Song and October 3 Premiere
content: Suikoden: The Anime , the anime adaptation of Suikoden II , revealed the ending song and an October 3 premiere in a third trailer. The anime was previously announced in March 2025 as an adaptation of Suikoden II , along with a new mobile game for the franchise.

title: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? Anime Teaser Trailer Revealed
content: The first teaser trailer for the anime Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? has released ahead of its January 2027 release date . Studio SynergySP is in charge of the animation, with Yasuaki Fujii as director.
